CORPUS_MEMBERSHIP_SCHEMA: dict[str, Any] = json.loads(r"""@@SCHEMA_JSON@@""")
_KINDS = {
    "CorpusItemRevision": "research-observatory-corpus-item-revision",
    "DiscoveryPath": "research-observatory-discovery-path",
    "CorpusDecision": "research-observatory-corpus-decision",

def _matches(value: object, node: dict[str, Any], depth: int = 0) -> bool:
    """Validate the bounded JSON Schema subset used by this generated contract."""

    if depth > 12:
        return False
    if "$ref" in node:
        reference = node["$ref"]
        return (
            isinstance(reference, str)
            and reference.startswith("#/$defs/")
            and _matches(value, CORPUS_MEMBERSHIP_SCHEMA["$defs"][reference[8:]], depth + 1)
        )
    if "const" in node and value != node["const"]:
        return False
    if "enum" in node and value not in node["enum"]:
        return False
    if "anyOf" in node and not any(_matches(value, option, depth + 1) for option in node["anyOf"]):
        return False
    if "oneOf" in node and sum(_matches(value, option, depth + 1) for option in node["oneOf"]) != 1:
        return False
    kind = node.get("type")
    if kind == "null":
        return value is None
    if kind == "string":
        if type(value) is not str or len(value) > 256:
            return False
        if "minLength" in node and len(value) < node["minLength"]:
            return False
        if "maxLength" in node and len(value) > node["maxLength"]:
            return False
        if "pattern" in node and re.search(node["pattern"], value) is None:
            return False
    if kind == "integer":
        if type(value) is not int or abs(value) > 9007199254740991:
            return False
        if "minimum" in node and value < node["minimum"]:
            return False
        if "maximum" in node and value > node["maximum"]:
            return False
    if kind == "array":
        if type(value) is not list or len(value) > 1000:
            return False
        if "minItems" in node and len(value) < node["minItems"]:
            return False
        if "maxItems" in node and len(value) > node["maxItems"]:
            return False
        if not all(_matches(child, node["items"], depth + 1) for child in value):
            return False
    if kind == "object":
        if type(value) is not dict or len(value) > 32 or any(type(key) is not str for key in value):
            return False
        properties = node["properties"]
        if node.get("additionalProperties") is False and any(key not in properties for key in value):
            return False
        if not all(key in value for key in node["required"]):
            return False
        if not all(_matches(child, properties[key], depth + 1) for key, child in value.items()):
            return False
    return True


def _sorted_unique(values: object) -> bool:
    return isinstance(values, list) and all(
        isinstance(value, str) and (index == 0 or values[index - 1] < value) for index, value in enumerate(values)
    )


def _canonical_utc_millis(value: str) -> bool:
    try:
        instant = datetime.fromisoformat(value[:-1] + "+00:00")
    except ValueError:
        return False
    return instant.isoformat(timespec="milliseconds").replace("+00:00", "Z") == value


def _semantic_error(item: dict[str, Any]) -> str | None:
    kind = item["documentType"]
    if kind == _KINDS["CorpusItemRevision"]:
        if item["itemId"] in {item["revisionId"], item["workId"]} or item["previousRevisionId"] == item["revisionId"]:
            return "corpus-item-identity-invalid"
        if item["duplicateOfItemId"] == item["itemId"]:
            return "corpus-duplicate-self-invalid"
        if not _sorted_unique(item["discoveryPathIds"]):
            return "corpus-discovery-paths-invalid"
        if item["previousRevisionId"] is None and (
            item["membership"] != "candidate"
            or item["review"] != "pending"
            or item["duplicateOfItemId"] is not None
            or item["availability"] != "unknown"
            or item["decisionRevisionId"] is not None
        ):
            return "corpus-initial-state-invalid"
        if item["previousRevisionId"] is not None and item["decisionRevisionId"] is None:
            return "corpus-decision-required"
        return None
    if kind == _KINDS["DiscoveryPath"]:
        if (
            item["pathId"] == item["itemId"]
            or item["sourceRevisionId"] == item["pathId"]
            or item["predecessorItemRevisionId"] in {item["itemId"], item["pathId"]}
        ):
            return "corpus-discovery-identity-invalid"
        if not _canonical_utc_millis(item["occurredAt"]):
            return "corpus-discovery-time-invalid"
        typed = (
            item["queryRevisionId"],
            item["citingWorkRevisionId"],
            item["recommendationRevisionId"],
            item["manualDecisionRevisionId"],
        )
        if item["kind"] == "import-member":
            if item["ordinal"] is None or item["ordinal"] < 1 or item["recordKeySha256"] is None or any(typed):
                return "corpus-import-path-invalid"
        elif item["kind"] == "connector-record":
            if (
                item["ordinal"] is None
                or item["ordinal"] > 999
                or item["recordKeySha256"] is not None
                or item["queryRevisionId"] is None
                or any(typed[1:])
            ):
                return "corpus-connector-path-invalid"
        else:
            expected = {
                "citation": item["citingWorkRevisionId"],
                "recommendation": item["recommendationRevisionId"],
                "manual": item["manualDecisionRevisionId"],
            }[item["kind"]]
            if (
                item["ordinal"] is not None
                or item["recordKeySha256"] is not None
                or expected is None
                or sum(value is not None for value in typed) != 1
            ):
                return "corpus-discovery-path-invalid"
        return None
    if kind == _KINDS["CorpusDecision"]:
        if item["previousRevisionId"] == item["nextRevisionId"] or item["decisionId"] in {
            item["itemId"],
            item["previousRevisionId"],
            item["nextRevisionId"],
        }:
            return "corpus-decision-identity-invalid"
        if not _sorted_unique(item["evidenceRevisionIds"]):
            return "corpus-decision-evidence-invalid"
        if item["previousValue"] == item["nextValue"]:
            return "corpus-decision-no-change"
        if (
            item["previousDecisionRevisionId"] == item["decisionId"]
            or item["supersedesDecisionRevisionId"] == item["decisionId"]
        ):
            return "corpus-decision-self-supersession"
        if (item["nextWorkId"] is not None) != (item["dimension"] == "work-reference"):
            return "corpus-decision-work-target-invalid"
        if not _canonical_utc_millis(item["occurredAt"]):
            return "corpus-decision-time-invalid"
        return None
    return "corpus-document-type-invalid"


def corpus_contract_errors(value: object) -> tuple[str, ...]:
    """Content-free validation errors; the caller retains all authority checks."""

    try:
        if type(value) is not dict or not _matches(value, CORPUS_MEMBERSHIP_SCHEMA):
            return ("corpus-contract-schema-invalid",)
        error = _semantic_error(value)
        return () if error is None else (error,)
    except TypeError, ValueError, KeyError, RecursionError:
        return ("corpus-contract-schema-invalid",)


def decode_corpus_document(value: object) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
    if corpus_contract_errors(value):
        return None
    try:
        owned = json.loads(json.dumps(value, allow_nan=False))
        return owned if not corpus_contract_errors(owned) else None
    except TypeError, ValueError, RecursionError:
        return None


def _encode(fields: Mapping[str, object], name: str) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
    """Envelope an exact Pydantic model_dump(mode='json', by_alias=True) without model imports."""

    if not isinstance(fields, Mapping) or any(not isinstance(key, str) for key in fields):
        return None
    node = CORPUS_MEMBERSHIP_SCHEMA["$defs"][name]
    expected = {field for field in node["required"] if field not in {"contractVersion", "documentType"}}
    if set(fields) != expected:
        return None
    document = {
        field: ("1.0.0" if field == "contractVersion" else _KINDS[name] if field == "documentType" else fields[field])
        for field in node["required"]
    }
    return decode_corpus_document(document)
